description: Polyphonic digital oscillator with 57 synthesis models, from analogue waveforms and noise through robot speech to physical models, chords and drums, plus a quantiser and an AD envelope

params.text: Detunes by up to a semitone either way
Sets the pitch in large steps, across the span the RANGE knob chooses
Attenuverts the FM input, an octave per volt at full clockwise and the same inverted at full counter-clockwise
Sets the first shaping parameter of the model in use, which is the main movement of its timbre
Attenuverts the TIMBRE input, 5V covering the whole TIMBRE knob range at full travel
Sets the second shaping parameter of the model in use, which is a second dimension of its tone
Steps through the 57 synthesis models; the display spells the four-letter code of the one in use, and the knob lights in a colour that follows the model
Sets what the COARSE knob covers: four octaves around the V/OCT input, four octaves around C3, an extended range that gives up accurate tracking, a fixed 440Hz, or an LFO range
Transposes by whole octaves, two either way
Delays the strike of the physical models after a trigger arrives, in seven steps
Sets the attack of the internal AD envelope
Sets the decay of the internal AD envelope
Sets how much of the internal AD envelope is added to the TIMBRE knob
Sets how much of the internal AD envelope is added to the pitch
Sets how much of the internal AD envelope is added to the COLOR knob
Sets the sample rate the output is reduced to, in seven steps
Sets the bit depth the output is reduced to, in seven steps
Switches the quantiser on and picks its scale from forty-eight of them, from semitones and church modes to blues, gamelan and Indian ragas; the display flashes the four-letter code of the choice
Sets the root note the quantiser builds its scale on; it is read only while a scale is chosen
Switches the internal AD envelope on, so a trigger opens an amplifier shaped by the ATK and DCY knobs; with it off the trigger input resets the oscillator phase instead
Sets how far the oscillator drifts out of tune, from off to full, imitating a poorly behaved analogue circuit
Detunes the oscillator at the low and the high ends of its range, imitating the tuning errors of an analogue circuit
Sets how much of the signature wave shaper is mixed in, from off to full, which adds grunge and glitches
Makes a change of more than a semitone at V/OCT produce a trigger of its own, so the physical models and the internal envelope can be played from a pitch cable alone

inputs.text: A voltage of 1V or more strikes the physical models, resets the phase of the others, and starts the internal AD envelope while VCA is on
Sets the pitch, one volt per octave, quantised to the scale the QNTZ knob selects
Shifts the pitch through the FM attenuverter, an octave per volt at full clockwise
Adds to the TIMBRE knob through the MOD attenuverter, 5V covering the whole knob range
Adds to the COLOR knob, 5V covering the whole knob range
Shifts the model up or down from the one the knob picks, 10V covering the whole list, with each polyphonic channel taking its own offset

outputs.text: The oscillator, ±5V, though loudness differs from one model to the next

notes: the module is polyphonic: the channel count comes from whichever of V/OCT and TRIG carries more channels, and each channel runs its own oscillator.
the COLOR input has no attenuverter: it is added to the COLOR knob at a fixed scale, where the TIMBRE input passes through the MOD knob first.
the signature wave shaper sounds different in every copy of the module, because its seed is taken from that module's own identifier; the menu can fix or replace the seed.
with nothing patched to TRIG and the AUTO button off, the physical and percussive models stay silent: they need a strike before they sound.
the two speech models play one of sixteen words on each trigger, TIMBRE scrubbing through the word and COLOR choosing which word; with nothing at TRIG they stay silent.
the five chord models follow the quantiser: with a scale chosen the chords stay in key and COLOR sets the extensions; with the quantiser off COLOR blends through sixteen fixed chords.
menu: Model — picks the synthesis model from a list giving each one's four-letter display code and its full name
Scale — picks the scale the quantiser uses, or switches the quantiser off
Options — the submenu holding the display and processing settings
Display channel — picks which polyphonic channel the model display reports. It is on the Options submenu
Low CPU (disable resampling) — runs the oscillator at the engine sample rate instead of resampling, costing less processing and adding aliasing. It is on the Options submenu
Signature wave shaper (SIGN) — the submenu for the seed the SIGN knob's wave shaper works from
Instance seed — takes the wave shaper seed from the module's own identifier, so that each copy sounds different; switching it off uses a seed of zero, as older versions did
Random seed — replaces the wave shaper seed with a new random one, and appears only while Instance seed is on
User seed — takes a seed typed into a text field, from 0 to 4294967295, entered with the return key, and appears only while Instance seed is on
